routerRule.condition: Call Jev only for partial-mode queries when Hex top1 is not strong (verdict not in [confirmed, likely]) and candidates >= 2
routerRule.acceptance: Take Jev choice only if strictly within shortlist and existing candidates
routerRule.verdictPolicy: Verdict strength is never promoted to strong by Jev alone; returns source: hex|jev
routerRule.failureMode: Fail-closed on any error, timeout, malformed response, or out-of-shortlist choice, returning hexResult unchanged
